stories.title: Mumbai property registrations hit four-year Diwali high
stories.summary: Mumbai recorded 3,683 property registrations during the 11-day Diwali period, the highest level in four years. While registrations rose by a marginal 0.4 percent year-on-year, revenue collections jumped 13 percent to Rs 384 crore. The data suggests that buyers are increasingly focused on higher-value housing segments.

stories.title: Mumbai real estate records four-year high during Diwali
stories.summary: Mumbai recorded 3,683 property registrations during the 11-day Diwali window, a 0.4 percent year-on-year increase. Revenue collections grew at a faster pace of 13 percent to reach Rs 384 crore. The figures reflect strong traction in higher-value housing segments during the city's festive season.

stories.title: Mumbai property registrations reach four-year Diwali high
stories.summary: Mumbai recorded 3,683 property registrations during the 11-day Diwali period, the highest level in four years. Revenue collections rose 13 percent to Rs 384 crore, outpacing the 0.4 percent growth in transaction volume. Industry leaders point to continued demand for premium homes as the primary driver.

stories.title: Mumbai property registrations hit four-year high during Diwali
stories.summary: Mumbai recorded 3,683 property registrations during the 11-day Diwali period, the highest for the festival in four years. Revenue collections grew 13 percent to Rs 384 crore, while registrations increased by 0.4 percent. The growth in revenue collections outpaced the increase in transaction volume.

stories.title: Mumbai property registrations rise 0.4 percent during Diwali
stories.summary: Mumbai recorded 3,683 property registrations during the 11-day Diwali period, a 0.4 percent increase over the previous year. Revenue collections grew by 13 percent to Rs 384 crore. The data from the Maharashtra Department of Registrations and Stamps marks a four-year high for the festive period.

stories.title: Hyderabad housing transaction value rises 3 percent
stories.summary: Hyderabad recorded a 3 percent year-on-year increase in housing transaction value to Rs 44,305 crore between January and October 2026, despite a 1 percent decline in registration volumes. Homes priced above Rs 1 crore accounted for half of the total transaction value. Premium housing continues to lead.

stories.title: Mumbai property market shows festive divergence
stories.summary: Mumbai recorded 3,683 property registrations during the 11-day Diwali period, a 0.4 percent increase. Revenue collections rose 13 percent to Rs 384 crore. The divergence between transaction volumes and revenue collections suggests that the market is becoming less dependent on volume for its financial growth.

stories.title: Lucknow civic body to open for tax applications
stories.summary: The Lucknow Municipal Corporation will keep its tax department and zonal cash counters open on November 14 to process applications for its one-time settlement scheme. Taxpayers have until December 15 to deposit outstanding property tax dues under the program. The civic body has directed staff to facilitate the process.

stories.title: Chopra family sells Pune property for Rs 6.5 crore
stories.summary: Madhu and Siddharth Chopra have agreed to sell a 3,754 square foot plot in Pune's Koregaon Park for Rs 6.5 crore. The deal was confirmed via property registration documents. The family has previously sold residential and commercial properties in Mumbai.

stories.title: Max Estates plans Rs 4,000 crore Gurugram project
stories.summary: Max Estates will develop a 7.25-acre housing project named The Bungalows near Golf Course Extension Road in Gurugram. The project will feature 243 residences with an estimated revenue potential of Rs 4,000 crore. The company says it is focusing on the Delhi-NCR property market.

stories.title: Max Estates launches luxury project in Gurugram
stories.summary: Max Estates has launched a residential project near Golf Course Extension Road in Gurugram with an estimated gross development value of Rs 4,000 crore. The development will include 243 units across two towers. The company says the project draws inspiration from the bungalow-style architecture of Lutyens Delhi.

stories.title: Shapoorji Pallonji eyes Rs 6,000 crore from township
stories.summary: Shapoorji Pallonji Real Estate plans to develop a 900-acre township in the Mumbai-Pune corridor with an estimated revenue of Rs 6,000 crore. The company, which entered the housing plot segment in 2025, reports strong demand for plotted developments despite a general slowdown in the broader housing market.

stories.title: Shapoorji Pallonji to develop 900-acre township
stories.summary: Shapoorji Pallonji Real Estate is planning a 900-acre housing township in the Mumbai-Pune corridor focused on plotted developments. The project targets Rs 6,000 crore in revenue. The company has invested Rs 1,500 crore in land and reports strong demand for plots despite a general housing market slowdown.

stories.title: Godrej Properties acquires land in Indore
stories.summary: Godrej Properties has acquired a 31-acre land parcel on Indore-Ujjain Road for a residential plotted development. The project has an estimated saleable area of 0.7 million square feet. The company plans to offer infrastructure, recreational spaces and amenities alongside the residential plots.

stories.title: Rustomjee Group deepens focus on redevelopment
stories.summary: Rustomjee Group has added 21 redevelopment projects to its portfolio since fiscal year 2023, representing 78 percent of its new additions. The projects have a combined gross development value of Rs 31,079 crore. The developer plans to continue focusing on redevelopment across Mumbai's western suburbs.

stories.title: Santacruz residents move court against builder
stories.summary: Forty-seven residents of a demolished housing society in Santacruz have approached the Bombay High Court seeking Rs 4.76 crore in outstanding dues. The residents have been awaiting transit rent and rehabilitation agreements for over two years since their buildings were declared dilapidated and subsequently demolished.

stories.title: Ansal Group directors arrested over dues
stories.summary: Three Ansal Group directors were arrested on November 11 after failing to clear outstanding dues of over Rs 77.66 crore to the Real Estate Regulatory Authority. Authorities detained the directors for 15 days under the Uttar Pradesh Revenue Code as part of the civil recovery process.

stories.title: Credai suggests flat scheme to resolve ownership hurdles
stories.summary: Credai officials claim the Mhaje Ghar and Mhajo Flat initiatives could resolve property ownership and conveyance hurdles in Goa. The schemes aim to provide legal security to long-term occupants without documents, allowing them to access bank loans and transfer property to heirs despite missing conveyance deeds.

stories.title: Swiggy leases office space in Bengaluru
stories.summary: Swiggy has leased 2.62 lakh square feet of office space in Bengaluru's Whitefield area for 10 years. The total rental outgo is estimated at approximately ₹241 crore, according to property registration documents. The company will occupy four floors in the Sumadhura Capitol Towers building.

stories.title: Pune leads automotive industrial leasing
stories.summary: The automotive and ancillary sector accounted for 28 percent of industrial leasing in Pune between 2024 and the first half of 2026. The sector leased 15 lakh square feet of the city's 54 lakh square feet total, according to a CBRE report. Pune remains the leading market.

stories.title: Flexible workspace leasing hits record highs
stories.summary: Gross office leasing across India reached 61.06 million square feet in the first nine months of 2026, according to JLL. Flexible workspace operators accounted for a record 13.83 million square feet of that total. The segment now represents 15.5 percent of all leasing activity in the country.

stories.title: SMARR Realty plans retail projects in Gurugram
stories.summary: SMARR Realty is planning commercial developments across Sectors 89 and 92 in New Gurugram. The projects will combine shopping, entertainment, and hospitality. Cushman and Wakefield reported 2.22 million square feet of gross retail leasing across India's top eight cities during the third quarter of 2026.

Best Way Trucking extends warehouse lease
stories.summary: Best Way Trucking Service has extended its lease for a 186,855-square-foot industrial building in East Hanover, New Jersey. The long-term agreement was signed while the existing lease remained in effect. The space will support the company's regional distribution operations and planned Foreign Trade Zone activities.

Westcore buys logistics center for $80.2 million
stories.summary: San Diego investor Westcore has purchased the Metro63 Logistics Center in Kannapolis for $80.2 million. The deal includes the fully leased warehouse and 23 acres of adjacent land. The facility is currently occupied by a tenant with active hiring plans.

stories.title: Rajasthan plans nine industrial zones
stories.summary: The Rajasthan government has approved nine new industrial areas across Kota and Bundi districts. The project aims to leverage connectivity from the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway and is expected to attract over ₹10,000 crore in investment. Land banks for the development have already been secured.

stories.title: Infrastructure struggles in Pune industrial belt
stories.summary: Automotive companies accounted for 28 percent of industrial leasing in Pune between 2024 and the first half of 2026. While the Chakan-Talegaon corridor remains a manufacturing hub, the concentration of factories and suppliers is reportedly testing the limits of local infrastructure governance.

stories.title: Nishati Power Technologies expands Mesa manufacturing footprint to meet military demand - KTAR News 92.3 FM
Dan Hoffler announces retirement
stories.summary: Dan Hoffler, founder of the company now known as AH Realty Trust, has announced his retirement at age 78. Hoffler led the firm for 47 years. The company recently dedicated a 23-story flagship building in Virginia Beach in his honor, renaming it the Hoffler Tower.

stories.title: Massive Linden warehouse becomes new headquarters for national distributor - NJ.com
Wall Street targets industrial outdoor storage
stories.summary: Institutional investors including Brookfield and Blackstone are increasing their focus on industrial outdoor storage lots. These sites, used for heavy equipment and idle vehicles, are being acquired as the AI build-out drives demand for machinery. The lots are increasingly viewed as a viable asset class.

stories.title: Data center stocks show profit growth
stories.summary: Five Indian companies operating in the AI data center and computing hardware sector reported significant financial performance in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. The firms are benefiting from increased demand for specialized computing capacity and infrastructure to support artificial intelligence models.

stories.title: The physical footprint of AI
stories.summary: AI models require physical infrastructure that consumes energy, water, and land. ChatGPT alone fields over 2.5 billion questions daily, requiring massive warehouses filled with servers. These facilities, often located in regions like Virginia or Hong Kong, represent the tangible environmental cost of digital queries.

stories.title: Hisar administration clears 990 acres for smart city project
stories.summary: The Hisar district administration has transferred 990 acres of land to the National Industrial Corridor Development Corporation for a new industrial cluster. Officials claim Hisar is the first site in the country to receive formal ownership transfer for the project. The land was previously held by civil aviation.

stories.title: Haryana begins land acquisition for Greater SPR project
stories.summary: The Haryana government has initiated land acquisition for the Greater Southern Peripheral Road, setting compensation rates for six villages at approximately 986 crore rupees. The project is intended to improve connectivity across Gurugram and surrounding areas. Infrastructure growth is now being priced by the village.

stories.title: Pune fast-tracks town planning for ring road acquisition
stories.summary: The Pune Municipal Corporation is expediting town planning schemes in Holkarwadi to facilitate land acquisition for a proposed ring road. The civic body has appointed a new arbitrator to resolve landowner issues and address mapping concerns. The project aims to reduce traffic congestion in the Pune region.

stories.title: Lucknow Development Authority to open Daliganj flyover
stories.summary: The Lucknow Development Authority is inaugurating a 1.1km flyover connecting Daliganj to Pakka Pul, part of the city's Green Corridor project. Officials state the two-lane structure will reduce travel time to two minutes. The city is also launching four new housing schemes later this month.

stories.title: Dilip Buildcon bids 419.47 crore for Gurugram metro depot
stories.summary: Dilip Buildcon has emerged as the lowest bidder for the construction of the Gurugram Metro depot at Sector 33, with a bid of 419.47 crore rupees. The project is expected to take 21 months to complete. Gurugram Metro Rail Limited has yet to formally award the contract.

stories.title: Dhule highway expansion plans move forward
stories.summary: The National Highways Authority of India is accelerating plans to widen the 76-kilometre route between Kopargaon and Malegaon to six lanes. The project is intended to improve goods movement across North Maharashtra. The proposal remains a collection of stretches until they are connected into a single system.

stories.title: Modi inaugurates Bengaluru Metro Pink Line
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has inaugurated the 7.5-kilometre elevated section of Bengaluru Metro's Pink Line. The route connects Kalena Agrahara to SG Palya and integrates with the Electronic City line at Jayadeva Hospital. The line opens to commuters on November 14 following several years of missed deadlines.

stories.title: Namo Bharat adds fast services on Delhi-Meerut corridor
stories.summary: The National Capital Region Transport Corporation is introducing eight limited-stop Namo Bharat services on the Delhi-Meerut line starting November 16. The operator claims the service will cover the distance between Anand Vihar and Ghaziabad in eight minutes. The full corridor will take under 50 minutes.

stories.title: Namo Bharat corridor adds fast trains
stories.summary: The National Capital Region Transport Corporation will add eight fast Namo Bharat services to the Delhi-Meerut corridor from November 16. The operator says these limited-stop trains will reduce the travel time between Anand Vihar and Ghaziabad to eight minutes. Commuters are promised a faster rush hour.

stories.title: Homebuyers body proposes national real estate tribunal
stories.summary: The Forum for People's Collective Efforts has proposed a National Appellate Tribunal for Real Estate to replace state-level bodies. The group also seeks to make sale agreements legally binding under RERA. The proposal aims to strengthen consumer protection through a new layer of national oversight.

stories.summary: Cabinet secretary TV Somanathan has assured a national homebuyers' body that their suggestions for strengthening RERA will be reviewed. Proposals include automatic compensation for project delays and a statutory exit option for refunds. The government is currently focusing on a new generation of deregulation reforms.

stories.title: TG RERA orders builder to refund 38 lakh rupees
stories.summary: The Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority has directed Jayathri Infrastructure to refund 38 lakh rupees to three homebuyers for an unregistered project. The authority mandated the payment include 10.85 percent annual interest within 90 days. The project was found to be operating without proper registration.

stories.title: MahaRERA rejects Pune homebuyer's parking claim
stories.summary: The Maharashtra Real Estate Regulatory Authority has dismissed a complaint from a homebuyer seeking a reserved parking space. The authority cited the registered Agreement for Sale, which explicitly stated the buyer did not want parking. Oral assurances were deemed insufficient evidence against the written contract.

stories.title: Punjab RERA limits builder's Covid relief
stories.summary: The Punjab Real Estate Regulatory Authority has granted a Zirakpur developer four months of relief for pandemic-related delays, rejecting the six months requested. The builder was ordered to pay 10.95 percent annual interest to the allottee. The authority cited the Real Estate Act for the ruling.

Nithya Raman wins Los Angeles mayoral race
stories.summary: Nithya Raman has been elected mayor of Los Angeles, defeating Karen Bass. The transition follows a decline in public support for the incumbent after the January 2025 wildfires. The real estate industry had previously expressed concern regarding the candidate's political affiliation.

stories.title: Pollution crackdown leads to 103 construction site closures
stories.summary: The Delhi Pollution Control Committee has ordered the closure of 103 construction sites following inspections of 3,000 locations between November 1 and 12. The crackdown is part of the city's winter action plan to mitigate dust pollution. Violations were identified at 153 sites in total.

stories.title: House of Abhinandan Lodha exits HDFC Capital partnership early
stories.summary: The House of Abhinandan Lodha has provided an early exit to HDFC Capital across five projects, returning 1,100 crore rupees. The developer says the move reflects its focus on disciplined asset management and execution-led growth. Early project deliveries have reportedly supported the necessary cash flows for the repayment.

stories.title: Truhome Finance secures SEBI approval for 3,000 crore rupee IPO
stories.summary: Truhome Finance, formerly known as Shriram Housing Finance, has received regulatory approval for a 3,000 crore rupee initial public offering. The offering consists of a 1,500 crore rupee fresh issue and an equal amount in an offer for sale by the promoter. Proceeds are intended for capital expansion.

stories.title: HiLITE Group launches Shariah-certified real estate fund
stories.summary: HiLITE Group is entering investment management with the launch of its HiLITE Ethical Fund 1, a Category II Alternative Investment Fund. The real estate-focused vehicle has a maximum size of 200 crore rupees and is certified by Taqwaa Advisory and Shariah Investment Solutions. It targets high-net-worth individuals.

stories.title: Commercial real estate inflows reach 5.5 billion dollars
stories.summary: Investment in India's commercial real estate sector rose 15 percent year-on-year in the first nine months of 2026, with cross-border inflows hitting 5.5 billion dollars. Grade A office assets currently generate yields between 7.75 and 8 percent. India remains one of the few regional markets offering high rental yields.

stories.summary: Some real estate agents are relying on AI to generate insights rather than disclosing their own lack of expertise. JournoConnect launches backlink service for real estate brands
stories.summary: JournoConnect has introduced a service to help real estate and wellness brands secure backlinks by monitoring journalist requests on platforms like HARO and Qwoted. The agency offers both per-placement and bundled pricing models to help experts earn quotes in editorial coverage. It is a service for sourcing requests.

stories.title: Vertropic expands PR services with Property Shortlist
stories.summary: Vertropic has expanded its PR offerings with a program that connects published property listings with buyer demand. The service aims to link licensed agents with subscribers based on location, budget, and purchase timeline. It consolidates publication, discovery, and direct contact opportunities into a single coordinated campaign.

stories.title: Scientists test laser-sintered lunar bricks
stories.summary: Researchers are using laser sintering to fuse lunar soil simulants into interlocking building blocks. The method aims to construct future habitats without requiring binders or materials transported from Earth. The team is currently exploring how these Lego-like bricks might be rearranged into different structures on the Moon.

stories.title: Researchers turn moon dust into building blocks
stories.summary: University of Arkansas researchers have demonstrated that simulated lunar dust can be 3D-printed into interlocking bricks without added materials. The approach aims to reduce the construction supplies NASA would need to transport from Earth. Building a lunar base might someday resemble assembling a giant Lego set.

stories.title: Construction projects face material shortages
stories.summary: Contractors are struggling with rising prices and shortages of stone and asphalt. The scarcity is directly affecting the progress of public investment projects, including the Provincial Road 845 Project. Construction units are currently attempting to source alternative supplies to keep their work moving forward.

stories.title: Ghana road program aims to improve infrastructure
stories.summary: The government's Big Push initiative seeks to improve road safety and promote trade through an expanded road network. The program aims to connect communities to economic opportunities, addressing years of poor maintenance that have contributed to road deterioration and increased transportation costs across the country.

stories.title: Ceramic bricks market enters 2026 with new focus
stories.summary: The global ceramic bricks market enters 2026 with disciplined procurement and a more regionally diversified supply architecture, according to IndexBox. The sector is navigating a complex landscape of inflationary pressures and shifting regulatory environments focused on sustainability. The market remains deeply integrated with global infrastructural development.

stories.title: Construction chemical containers market evolves
stories.summary: The construction chemical containers market enters 2026 with broader demand fundamentals and a more diversified supply architecture, according to IndexBox. The sector provides packaging for products ranging from concrete admixtures to waterproofing compounds. Manufacturers are now adjusting to more sophisticated chemical formulations and stricter environmental standards.

stories.title: Brick pavers market shows resilience
stories.summary: The global brick pavers market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement and a diversified supply architecture, according to IndexBox. The sector is navigating inflationary pressures while maintaining demand for hardscaping applications. The market continues to balance aesthetic appeal with functional performance and durability requirements.

stories.title: Natural stone market reaches $10.6 billion
stories.summary: The global natural stone market reached $10.6 billion in 2025, according to Grand View Research. China remains the largest exporter with a 32 percent global share. For architects and contractors, the supplier decision now turns on documented project support and material availability for granite and marble.

stories.title: Construction industry faces plastic waste critique
stories.summary: Oliver Lawton of the Copper Sustainability Partnership is calling for the construction industry to rethink its reliance on plastic materials. The critique highlights the environmental impact of current building choices and suggests that the sector must move toward more sustainable alternatives to address the growing waste crisis.

stories.title: Green Building Congress to convene in Mumbai
stories.summary: The Indian Green Building Council will host its 24th Green Building Congress in Mumbai from November 26 to 28. The three-day event expects over 3,000 delegates and 150 thought leaders to discuss sustainable construction and India's transition toward net zero building practices.

stories.title: India marks 25 years of green building growth
stories.summary: India now has 20,620 registered green building projects covering 16.55 billion square feet, making it the world's second-largest green building market. The Indian Green Building Council, which started in a small Hyderabad office, celebrates its 25th anniversary this year at a congress in Mumbai.

stories.title: IGBC targets net-zero urban growth
stories.summary: India has established itself as the world's second-largest green building market with 20,620 registered projects. The Indian Green Building Council is marking its 25th anniversary by hosting an international conference in Mumbai from November 26 to 28 to discuss the nation's net-zero urban growth momentum.

stories.title: Summit addresses climate resilience in Bengal
stories.summary: The Green Bengal Summit 2026 brought together policymakers and urban planners in Kolkata to discuss climate-resilient development. The event focused on integrated urban regeneration and net zero carbon pathways, aiming to future-proof the region against environmental pressures through sustainable growth strategies.

stories.title: India and Norway explore waste-to-resource projects
stories.summary: India and Norway are exploring joint initiatives to convert industrial and construction waste into infrastructure materials. The collaboration, discussed in New Delhi, focuses on developing technology to turn waste into resources for roads and buildings within the cement and construction sectors.

stories.title: Cement sector seeks policy support for net zero
stories.summary: The Global Cement and Concrete Association says the industry is pursuing emissions reductions while maintaining essential infrastructure supply. A report presented at COP31 stresses that enabling policies are required to bring transformative technologies to commercial scale. Cement remains vital as global populations continue to grow.

stories.title: Fuchs Lubricants achieves net zero certification
stories.summary: Fuchs Lubricants South Africa has received a Net Zero Carbon Level 2 certification for its headquarters in Isando. The rating recognizes the company's commitment to low-carbon operations and sustainable design, placing the facility among a select group of buildings focused on reducing environmental impact.

stories.title: Eco-friendly materials used in mini home project
stories.summary: A new project highlights the process of building a small wooden house using environmentally friendly materials. The initiative aims to demonstrate simple techniques for eco-conscious builders, showcasing the advantages of sustainable construction materials in creating a cozy and energy-efficient dwelling.

stories.title: Hospitality sector faces ESG pressure
stories.summary: Climate change is forcing hospitality companies to reconsider their operations as environmental degradation accelerates. Sustainability has shifted from a corporate phrase to a key business priority. Companies are now focusing on reducing greenhouse gas emissions and developing strategies to remain resilient against social and environmental pressures.

stories.title: US home sales reach 16-year low
stories.summary: Sales of previously owned US homes fell 5.5 percent in October to an annual rate of 3.75 million units. The National Association of Realtors reports this is the lowest level since August 2010. Rising mortgage rates stemming from the war with Iran have depressed demand for residential property.

stories.title: US home prices record first annual decline in three years
stories.summary: Redfin reports the median US home sale price fell 0.4 percent to $388,634 in October. This marks the first annual decline since May 2023. More than one third of homes sold featured a price cut, and 61 percent of properties sold for less than the original asking price.

stories.title: Rental demand drops as prices dip in 24 major metros
stories.summary: Zillow reports that rental demand fell 6.7 percent from September to October, leading to price drops in 24 major metro areas. The typical asking rent remained flat at $1,913. While this is 2.9 percent higher than a year ago, renters may now have room to negotiate.

Protests held across Portugal over housing costs
stories.summary: Tens of thousands marched in over 30 Portuguese cities to demand rent limits and affordable housing. Portugal saw its home price-to-income ratio rise 61 percent between 2015 and 2025. The government has promised 145,000 new homes, though it acknowledges that relief for residents will take time.

stories.title: Fire-ravaged Malibu property heads to auction
stories.summary: Hiroshi Horiike is auctioning a 5.35-acre Malibu property where his mansion stood before the 2018 Woolsey Fire. The land, which once carried a $29.8 million asking price, will be sold via a sealed-bid auction with a reserve of $12.99 million. Horiike purchased the site for $12.25 million.

stories.title: Mark Zuckerberg buys Irish castle estate
stories.summary: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan purchased Strancally Castle in County Waterford for €51.17 million. While the estate spans 440 acres, the registered price covers the residence and one acre of land. The transaction was confirmed following its appearance in Ireland's Property Price Register.
